title: runtime-configurator-for-policy-based-retention-and-evidence-streaming
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a runtime-configurable TTL allocator and evidence-streaming pipeline that derives retention for prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics from an authoritative policy set. The feature should support per-tenant, per-route, and per-region derivation, allow deterministic purge orchestration, and emit continuous evidence manifests to a region-aware archive for audits. This ticket covers the runtime components, API surface for policy overrides, streaming hooks for live evidence delivery, and operational rollback controls.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime exposes a /retention/evaluate API that returns effective TTL, retention-class, and evidence-channel for a given tenant+route+metadata payload.
Policy derivation supports precedence: explicit route > tenant profile > org default > global default, and this precedence is documented and tested.
Deterministic purge plan generator can simulate and output signed manifests for a time window and is consumable by the purge worker.
Evidence-streaming pipeline writes sharded, region-tagged manifests to customer-owned buckets (or escrow buckets for hosted), with per-manifest audit hashes and delivery receipts.
Console exposes a live-preview showing computed retention for sample requests and an override toggle for emergency short-lived TTL changes.
End-to-end tests in CI validate retention evaluation, purge manifest generation, and evidence delivery against a mock S3 and mock KMS.
Security review signoff completed and keys used for manifest signing are KMS-backed.
Performance: evaluation API tail-latency at p99 <= 25ms under production-like load in dedicated tests.
tasks: Design retention evaluation proto and API contract
Implement expression engine bootstrap for declarative retention rules (DRE)
Integrate evaluation into serving runtime cache layer with memoization
Build purge manifest generator with deterministic ordering and audit hash-chaining
Implement evidence-streaming worker with backpressure and region routing
Add console live-preview UI hooks and override endpoints (coord with PM/Design)
Create CI tests and perf benchmark harness
Coordinate security review and KMS integration

notes: Key trade-offs: 1) Keep DRE small to avoid execution risk in the serving path; complex policy functions will be precompiled offline into DRE-compatible rules. 2) Evidence streaming is append-only and uses signed manifests to avoid mutability concerns — manifests point to object bundles sharded by region and tenant. 3) For performance, memoize evaluation results keyed by (tenant, route, policy-hash) with TTL aligned to shortest policy TTL to minimize stale evaluations. Rollout plan: feature-flag evaluation path, soft-launch on low-traffic tenants, then enable sampling for higher tiers before full enablement.
